hypotheses.E1_exact_contraction: The unfactored contracted tensor reproduces the native projected-MLP write with maximum relative error below 1e-5.
hypotheses.E2_rank128_preserves_hybrid: Rank-128 factorization adds median KL at most 0.005 relative to the exact Hybrid-64 model on every corpus.
hypotheses.E3_rank128_native_fidelity: Rank-128 factorization has median native-model KL at most 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E4_rank128_compute_reduction: Rank-128 factorization uses at least ten times fewer counted dense multiplications per token than the native MLP.
hypotheses.E5_rank64_useful: Rank-64 factorization adds median KL at most 0.01 relative to exact Hybrid-64 on every corpus.
